claims.object_text: promising biomarker of AD-related synapse degeneration in cerebrospinal fluid
claims.quote: Vesicle-associated membrane protein 2 (VAMP-2) has emerged as a promising biomarker of AD-related synapse degeneration in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

claims.object_text: VAMP-2 changes in CSF reflect AD biomarkers and cognitive performance across multiple domains
claims.quote: Our novel digital immunoassay accurately measures VAMP-2 changes in CSF, which reflect AD biomarkers and cognitive performance across multiple domains.

claims.object_text: CSF concentrations of VAMP-2 were lower in preclinical AD stage 1 compared to controls and higher at later AD stages compared to AD stage 1; associated with core AD biomarkers, particularly total tau
claims.quote: CSF concentrations of VAMP-2, neurogranin and SNAP-25 were lower in preclinical AD stage 1 compared to controls and higher at later AD stages compared to AD stage 1 and were associated with core AD biomarkers, particularly total tau (adj. r2 = 0.62 to 0.78, p < 0.001).

claims.object_text: associated with all cognitive domains in individuals on the AD continuum
claims.quote: All three synaptic proteins were associated with all cognitive domains in individuals on the AD continuum (adj. r2 = 0.04 to 0.19, p < 0.05).

claims.object_text: native VAMP-2 protein detected in human brain homogenates
claims.quote: Assay antibodies detected native VAMP-2 protein in human brain homogenates.
